listing.name: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate (WindowSmash)
listing.summary: WindowSmash builds Super Smash Bros. Ultimate 13.0.5 from your own Switch game. The project reports matches on Windows and menus on Apple silicon Mac. Linux support is experimental. The alpha tags contain no downloadable player.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Prepare your own base and matching update or a merged 13.0.5 dump, prod.keys, title.keys and firmware NCAs for fonts. XCI, NSP and NCA are accepted. Expand NSZ or XCZ first.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Use the project’s source installer to download the tools and compile locally. The primary Windows 10 or 11 x64 route needs AVX2 and Direct3D 11. Mac source targets Apple silicon on macOS 14.5 or later.

warnings: Keep the original game data after compiling. The player may still need it during play.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The Linux route uses DXVK and Vulkan, with CPU support unconfirmed. Two-PC matches, physical controllers and the online roster have limited testing.
